info.title: approval-ui
info.description: Approval UI is a static React + TypeScript single-page app. It is a kind=ui service whose frozen contract has service.provides = [] — it serves no HTTP API of its own (no src/app.ts, no routes, no /health of its own). The browser bundle calls the orchestrator's dependency contract (see x-consumes below) directly from src/api/orchestratorClient.ts; nothing in this repository is exposed for other services to call.
